df_01.finding: Stage E scores a qualifier preserved when at least half of its lexical anchors reach the paragraph. A qualifier phrased in its own claim's vocabulary is therefore scored preserved by a verbatim copy of the canonical sentence, which states the qualifier's meaning nowhere.
df_01.root_cause: lexical anchor overlap is used as a proxy for semantic realisation; the proxy is vacuous whenever the qualifier's anchors are drawn from the claim it qualifies

remedy.design: registered qualifier semantics - explicit, deterministic required-meaning constructions per registered qualifier, following DSC-C002-001
remedy.rejected_alternative: raising the half-anchor threshold to a higher percentage; it is the same lexical heuristic with a different constant, would create false rejects on faithful prose that renders the meaning in other words, and would still pass a verbatim copy whose anchor overlap happens to be total
